title: Why Has Shadows of Ashenfall Been Cancelled & What Now? - RuneScape Dragonwilds News & Updates
author: IAmWaved
chapters: What Happens With Shadows of Ashenfall Now?
description:
The Shadows of Ashenfall Update that has long been planned for #runescapedragonwilds does now look to be cancelled. The update itself has since transformed and evolved into the concept, and now realisation of #runescape4, and so today we're going to discuss how this may have came about and what it means for both games moving forward.
